## Script Summary 
- Loads harmonized meta data RDS file

- Adds meta data to all SummarizedExperiment objects for the RPPA omics layer

- Filter and save SummarizedExperiment objects 


## Path Setting
Load in metadata RDS object and define directory with SummarizedExperiment objects
```{r data loading}
#Where the meta data RDS file is
metadata <- readRDS(file.path(TCGA,"metadata/data/harmonized_metadata.rds"))

#Path where the summarized experiment objects you are updating are located
se_directory <- file.path(TCGA,"RPPA/raw_data/raw_SE/")
```


## Filtering Proteins
RPPA data quality control guidelines are almost non existent. We will remove proteins with >30% missing values. 

Data is already normalized by TCGA. 

```{r}
filter_proteins <- function(se_obj, max_missing = 30) {
  # Calculate the percentage of missing values for each protein (row)
  row_na_percentage <- rowMeans(is.na(assay(se_obj))) * 100
  
  # Identify proteins to keep (<= max_missing% missing values)
  proteins_to_keep <- row_na_percentage <= max_missing
  
  # Filter the SummarizedExperiment object
  se_obj_filtered <- se_obj[proteins_to_keep, ]
  
  # Calculate the number of proteins removed
  proteins_removed <- sum(!proteins_to_keep)
  
  # Print the number of proteins removed
  message(paste0("Number of Proteins with >", max_missing, "% missing values removed: ", proteins_removed))
  
  # Return the filtered object and count of removed proteins
  list(
    filtered_data = se_obj_filtered,
    proteins_removed = proteins_removed
  )
}

```




## Process all RPPA Summarized Experiment Objects in folder
Here we loop through all SummarizedExperiment RDS files, check if the shortened ID is the column names (and sets the barcode as the column if not), and add the harmonzied meta data to the SummarizedObject (which is then saved). 

This assumes the data has only one of each "bcr_patient_barcode", which should be the case given only primary tumors were downloaded.

Note: Other layers set the new column names as the "submitter_id", but this column does not exist for RPPA (GDCprepare does not work for RPPA data, so only a few metadata columns are added). For RPPA, the "bcr_patient_barcode" corresponds to the sample id in the other layers. 

We also apply our filtering function to our SummarizedExperiment objects (removing proteins with >30% missing values)

```{r Add Meta Data to Folder of Summarized Experiments}
# Define directories for saving all and filtered data
filtered_directory <- file.path(TCGA, "RPPA/processed_data/filtered")
all_directory <- file.path(TCGA, "RPPA/processed_data/all")

# Create directories if they don't exist
#dir.create(filtered_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
#dir.create(all_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Create a list of all .rds files in the se_directory
file_list <- list.files(path = se_directory, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize removal table
removal_table <- data.frame(
  Cancer_Type = character(),
  Proteins_Removed = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop through each file
for(file in file_list) {
  
  cat("Processing file:", file, "\n")
  
  # Read in the SummarizedExperiment object
  se_obj <- readRDS(file)
  
  # Ensure 'bcr_patient_barcode' is set as the column names
  if (!identical(colnames(se_obj), colData(se_obj)$bcr_patient_barcode)) {
    message("Setting 'bcr_patient_barcode' as column names for ", file)
    colnames(se_obj) <- colData(se_obj)$bcr_patient_barcode
  }
  
  # Determine samples to keep based on metadata
  samples_to_keep <- intersect(colnames(se_obj), rownames(metadata))
  
  # Extract project-specific metadata
  project_specific_metadata <- metadata[samples_to_keep, ]
  
  # Convert metadata to DataFrame if necessary
  project_specific_metadata <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(project_specific_metadata)
  
  # Sort the SummarizedExperiment columns to match metadata
  se_obj_sorted <- se_obj[, match(rownames(project_specific_metadata), colnames(se_obj))]
  
  # Verify that the samples match
  if (identical(colnames(se_obj_sorted), rownames(project_specific_metadata))) {
    
    # Add metadata to colData
    colData(se_obj_sorted) <- project_specific_metadata
    
    # Save the unfiltered SummarizedExperiment to the "all" directory
    all_output_path <- file.path(all_directory, basename(file))
    saveRDS(se_obj_sorted, all_output_path)
    
    # Apply the protein filtering function
    filtered_results <- filter_proteins(se_obj_sorted, max_missing = 30)
    
    # Save the filtered SummarizedExperiment to the "filtered" directory
    filtered_output_path <- file.path(filtered_directory, basename(file))
    saveRDS(filtered_results$filtered_data, filtered_output_path)
    
    # Extract cancer type from the file name (assuming format like TCGA-BRCA_rppa.rds)
    cancer_type <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
    
    # Append the removal counts to the removal_table
    removal_table <- rbind(removal_table, data.frame(
      Cancer_Type = cancer_type,
      Proteins_Removed = filtered_results$proteins_removed,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
  } else {
    # If there's a mismatch in sample names, throw an error
    stop(paste("Mismatch between column names and metadata samples in file:", file))
  }
}


reactable::reactable(removal_table,searchable = TRUE, resizable = TRUE)
```
